dialect.detail: RM/COBOL as indicated by SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER set to RMCOBOL; uses DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (Turkish locale), LINKAGE SECTION with DEPENDING ON for argument passing typical of RM/COBOL runtime
evidence: PIC X OCCURS 1 TO 100 DEPENDING ON MAIN-ARGUMENT-SIZE

purpose.domain_detail: Stock/inventory management system - Turkish language identifiers (STOK=stock, ADET=quantity/count, DEPO=warehouse, GIR=entry, CIK=exit). Processes batch operations (insert/update/delete) on stock quantity records.
purpose.summary: This program reads an input file of stock quantity operation records and applies insert, update, or delete operations to a stock file (STOKADET). It is called as a subprogram receiving a filename argument via LINKAGE SECTION, opens the file, processes each record by operation code (0=delete, 1=insert, 2=update), then closes files and exits.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with variable-length argument (DEPENDING ON)
5 COPY statements including fileop.cpy with REPLACING clause
GO TO used for loop control (GO DOSYA-OKU)
EXIT PROGRAM followed by STOP RUN pattern
verdict.notes: Turkish-language identifiers throughout (STOK, ADET, DEPO, GIR, CIK, YIL, KATNO, STNO). The COPY fileop.cpy uses REPLACING with both == == and quoted delimiters. Tab character visible before 'copy fileop.var' line suggesting minor formatting inconsistency. No SQL or CICS. Part of a larger stock management system with shared copybooks.
